Compared key sets and key order with the English source; every key present exactly once, no duplicate JSON members (object_pairs_hook), no BOM, CR, NBSP, bidi controls or unindented key lines, final newline present.

Parsed every message with @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser 3.5.21 (the generator's parser) with requiresOtherClause: true; compared argument sets and number/date skeleton sets; this namespace has no select/date/time/rich-text tokens beyond those reported below.

Rendered the new keys through the shipped messages.t() runtime bundled with esbuild from a mirror of the head src/i18n tree, under locale zh-CN and en, at counts 0/1/3/7/1234567; the outputs quoted below are actual t() returns.
Ran negative controls on the same checks: deleting one {list} occurrence, renaming count to cnt and deleting the other arm were each caught, so the placeholder/other-clause checks are not vacuous.
limitations: Static catalogue and message-runtime audit only: no rendered screen, screenshot or pixel measurement was produced, so width statements are code-point cell arithmetic against the English maxCells hints, not measured layout.
